data.content_ref: inline:SRC_004 contradicts SRC_003: SRC_004 claims the fetch budget should be solely in bytes, while SRC_003 claims it should be solely in requests. These are mutually exclusive design choices. Refuted if: there exists a scenario where both a bytes-only budget and a requests-only budget can be simultaneously satisfied without conflict, e.g., if all responses have identical size, making bytes and requests proportional, so the budgets are effectively equivalent and not contradictory.
